brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the cholesterol lowering effects of an investigational drug in patients with mixed hyperlipidemia (high cholesterol and high triglycerides).
brief_title: A Study to Evaluate an Investigational Drug in Patients With Mixed Hyperlipidemia (0653A-071)(COMPLETED)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and women 18-79 years of age with high cholesterol and high triglycerides.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals who do not meet specific cholesterol or triglyceride levels as required by the study.

official_title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Ezetimibe/Simvastatin and Fenofibrate Coadministration in Patients With Mixed Hyperlipidemia
